title: Darley Australia Pty Ltd - proposed acquisition of Woodlands Stud

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: On 16 April 2008, Darley Australia Pty Ltd advised the ACCC that it proposed to acquire Woodlands Stud from Inghams Enterprises Ltd.
body_sections.Market definition: Without reaching a final view, the ACCC considered that the relevant market was likely to be the market for breeding thoroughbred horses in Australia.
body_sections.Competition analysis: On 9 May 2008, the ACCC formed the view that the acquisition would be unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition. Factors informing this conclusion included: - the merged entity's market share would only increase by a small amount in terms of total number of stallions and in terms of stallion service fee revenues in the market for breeding thoroughbred horses in Australia; - there is a large degree of risk associated with breeding thoroughbred horses such that the likelihood of any one stud farm establishing, maintaining or exercising market power over a substantial period of time appears to be relatively low; and - barriers to entry into the national market for breeding thoroughbred horses appear to be relatively low.
